description: Orthostatic vital signs were not documented during hospital stay despite patient reporting dizziness suspected to be related to medication or volume status.
evidence_in_history: Visit 2: Primary Care Follow-up (2024-06-20) notes dizziness possibly related to antihypertensive medications or volume status and plans to check orthostatic vitals at next visit.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital Course section states orthostatic vital signs were not formally documented during the stay despite reports of dizziness.
suggested_correction: Formally document orthostatic vital signs during hospitalization or subsequent visits to evaluate dizziness and guide management of antihypertensive therapy.

description: No medication adjustments or plans for insulin dose titration were made despite persistently elevated HbA1c (~7.5%) indicating suboptimal glycemic control.
evidence_in_history: Multiple HbA1c values above target (7.4-7.6%), suboptimal glycemic control noted in assessments; Visit 2 reinforces need for improved glycemic control but no medication changes documented.
evidence_in_summary: Hospital course notes no new insulin adjustments were made during hospitalization; dose details remained as prior to admission.
suggested_correction: Consider adjusting diabetic medications including insulin dosing and/or initiating additional therapies to improve glycemic control; document medication review and plan.

description: Despite ongoing mild anemia indicated by borderline low hemoglobin and mild pallor on exam, no specific anemia work-up or management plan is provided.
evidence_in_history: Lab history shows stable but borderline low hemoglobin (~12.7-12.9 g/dL), and physical exam notes mild pallor at Visit 2.
evidence_in_summary: Secondary diagnoses include mild anemia; no investigations or treatment plans mentioned.
suggested_correction: Document anemia evaluation or plan (e.g., iron studies, nutritional assessment) and consider treatment if indicated.

description: Cardiology follow-up plans are vague, noted as 'as needed or sooner with symptom worsening' without a scheduled appointment to ensure close monitoring of CHF and CKD progression after hospitalization.
evidence_in_history: Visit 1 and 2 plans mention follow-up intervals but no scheduled cardiology appointment post-hospitalization.
evidence_in_summary: Discharge summary indicates cardiology follow-up 'as needed or sooner' but lacks specific appointment scheduling.
suggested_correction: Schedule and document a specific cardiology follow-up appointment to monitor cardiac status and medication effects after discharge.
